highlights: Santa's Railroad Wonderland at the Texas Transportation Museum runs train rides to Wallaceville on six weekend nights, December 5, 6, 12, 13, 19 and 20, 2026, from 5:30 to 9 pm, with visits with Santa at no extra charge ($15 adults, $12 kids 4 to 12).
Milberger's Traditional Christmas Celebration on December 5 and 6, 2026, from 10 am to 2 pm, lists rides on the Little Red Choo-Choo, photos with Santa, balloon art and face painting.
The free H-E-B Christmas Tree Lighting at Travis Park is Friday, November 27, 2026, 4 to 7 pm, with the tree lit at 6 pm, a letters to Santa station, crafts and a visit from Santa.

Museum Reach River of Lights on Saturday, December 12, 2026, 4 to 8 pm at the San Antonio River Lock and Dam is free and includes 100,000 pounds of real snow, two snow slides and free pictures with Santa.
Holiday in the Garden at Hemisfair's Yanaguana Garden on Saturday, December 19, 2026, 11 am to 3 pm is free and features real reindeer, carolers, crafts and treats.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in San Antonio for 2026, and here is what he found: 82 family events across San Antonio and 5 nearby towns, 34 of them free. The magic runs from November 12 (SeaWorld San Antonio Christmas Celebration) through January 10, with Zoo Lights powered by CPS Energy (November 14 to January 3), The Holiday Market and Lights Alive Drive Thru Light Show (November 20 to December 31) and Dr. Seuss' How The Grinch Stole Christmas (November 21 to December 24) along the way. New in this update: Lights Alive at Alamo Ranch (November 26 to January 2), Paca the Halls at Alamo Ranch Alpacas (November 26 to December 22) and The Light Park San Antonio at Wolff Stadium (November 26 to January 3). We check every date on the host’s own website, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our Texas Christmas events for kids guide.

Looking outside the city? Each San Antonio suburb has its own guide: New Braunfels, Schertz, Seguin, Cibolo, Converse, Universal City, Canyon Lake, Boerne and Helotes.

What Rally found in San Antonio

  • 82 Christmas events for kids in San Antonio and 5 nearby towns, including Fredericksburg, Garden Ridge and Live Oak
  • 34 free events, including 45th Annual Ford Holiday River Parade and Lighting Ceremony, H-E-B Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony at Travis Park and Holiday Lights on the River Walk
  • Meet Santa: 35 chances, including SeaWorld San Antonio Christmas Celebration (November 12 to January 4) and Holiday in the Park (November 21 to January 4)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Fredericksburg's Christmas Nights of Lights (November 24 to January 5), 45th Annual Ford Holiday River Parade and Lighting Ceremony (November 27) and H-E-B Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony at Travis Park (November 27)
  • Also on the list: 15 Christmas shows, 12 Christmas light displays, 3 Christmas markets, 2 train rides, 2 craft workshops and 1 ice rink
  • Season: November 12 (SeaWorld San Antonio Christmas Celebration) to January 10 (Illuminate, presented by H-E-B)
  • Every date checked on the host’s own site on Nov 26
